title: Minimum Absolute Difference Between Two Values
summary: Given an array of integers consisting solely of 0, 1, and 2, find the minimum absolute difference between indices where the value is 1 and the value is 2.
statement: Given an array of integers consisting solely of 0, 1, and 2, find the minimum absolute difference between indices where the value is 1 and the value is 2. If no such pair exists, return -1. The absolute difference between indices i and j is the absolute value of their difference.
constraints: nums contains only zero, one, and two.
Return the minimum absolute index difference between an occurrence of one and an occurrence of two.
Return -1 if either value is absent.
hints: Track the latest indices of one and two.
When one appears, compare it with the latest two; do the symmetric check for a two.
The nearest opposite value to the left is always its latest occurrence.
Taking the minimum of these crossing distances finds the global minimum.
editorial: Taking the minimum of these crossing distances finds the global minimum.

tests.explanation: The two at index three is two positions from the one at index five.
